description: Agent Wonderland is a marketplace and payment layer for agent-ready APIs. This endpoint runs TechAnalysis - Technical Analysis: 18 technical indicators + AI signal summary for any ticker. RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, ADX, EMA/SMA, Stochastic, OBV, VWAP, support/resistance, candlestick patterns. Covers crypto, equities, commodities,... Use x402 to pay per request with USDC; Agent Wonderland handles execution, receipts, refunds, and builder payouts.
